logline: Two ordinary people use slow belly breathing to settle after a stressful moment, at home and on a lunch break.
style: Quiet contemporary drama, natural window light, soft sage and warm neutral palette, 50mm lens, shallow depth of field, gentle handheld stillness, no clinical settings
negative_prompt: text, captions, logos, watermarks, hospitals, doctors, medical equipment, pills, distress, crying, distorted hands, flicker

shots.prompt: A woman in her forties in a cardigan sits on a sofa in a softly lit living room in the early evening, laptop just closed beside her, shoulders slightly raised and tense, looking out of the window.
shots.narration: When stress builds, your breath can help you settle.

shots.prompt: The same woman in her forties in a cardigan sits back on the sofa, feet flat on the floor, rests one hand gently on her belly and lets her shoulders drop. Soft evening window light, calm living room.
shots.narration: Get comfortable, and let each breath go deep into your belly.

shots.prompt: Close-up of a woman's hand resting on her belly over a soft cardigan, rising slowly and evenly as she breathes in, warm window light falling across the fabric.
shots.narration: Breathe in gently through your nose, counting slowly to five.

shots.prompt: Close-up of the woman in her forties with her eyes closed, face relaxing as she breathes out slowly through softly parted lips, soft evening light, peaceful expression.
shots.narration: Then let it out gently through your mouth, for another count of five.

shots.prompt: A man in his thirties in a work shirt sits on a park bench at lunchtime under a tree, eyes closed, hands resting in his lap, breathing slowly while people pass in the soft-focus background. Dappled sunlight.
shots.narration: Keep going for at least five minutes. You can do it almost anywhere.

shots.prompt: A calm living room at dusk, a sofa with a folded blanket, soft lamp light and a window showing a pale evening sky.
